notes.title: LITTLE UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Fixed Bugs：[/b]
1、Fixed the issue where no new Color Sprite spawning after firing Color Sprite for a long time.
2、Fixed the issue where Color Sprite sometimes not self-destruct after collision.

[b]New Features:[/b]
1、The progress bar, by which players can better control the game progress. The progress bar can be displayed or hidden in the settings page, and is displayed by default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39660321/32908c5455a0f3f75ff85c8a888e64c857d83638.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39660321/f73726222d84cf0769ef094892bd0082a3382197.png[/img]
